entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2968097043228517120: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 25606: distance 49.164 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.009), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 49.164 +/- 0.442 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 20.8697 +/- 0.2047 mas (same row, RUWE 3.28), 101.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -5.748, -83.650 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2968097043228517120 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 15.495 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 25606: radius 15.495 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 165.621 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.048) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5264 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 25606: effective temperature 5264 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,264 K and log g 2.81 (u1 0.556, u2 0.198): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.81 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 14 published values span log g 2.1 to 2.96, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness.
